scientific_report.intervention: query row r -> (r+1) mod40, fixed signed utilities/bias
scientific_report.inference: No p-values, utility/generalization/necessity/L5 or new-method claim.
scientific_report.cache_identity_scope: New train-only reconstruction; old-cache byte/numeric equivalence unproven

supported: The global near-identical-query/collapsed-attention explanation is contradicted for this fixed head and cohort: all 780 query pairs have raw and cohort-mean effective fidelity below 0.99, and cohort-mean attention TV above 0.01.

The prescribed target-blind cyclic reassignment impairs the frozen readout descriptively: mean CE rises from 0.22072 to 0.45858, with 234 harmed versus 62 corrected predictions and 305 prediction changes. Query-to-row assignment therefore matters under this particular intervention.

The reported geometry and logit bounds have zero observed violations. Small normalization, reduction and ideal/native residuals support numerical consistency within the stated implementation and tolerances.
The reported strict full-40-logit certificate covers 234 of 2048 original decisions against this cyclic perturbation; all certified decisions remain unchanged.

The synthetic counterexample establishes that raw query fidelity alone cannot determine contextual attention similarity. The present diagnostic separately contradicts global collapse in the original trained head on this cohort.
unsupported: Per-sentence noncollapse or distinguishability for every query pair: effective fidelity and TV summaries average over sentences.
Held-out generalization, independent replication, robustness across seeds, or conclusions covering the three unsupported classes.
Necessity of every query, a minimal query count, optimal assignment, or a semantic explanation based on class indices.
Causal mediation of total model gains, attribution of those gains to quantum geometry, or necessity of quantum resources, phases or relation conditioning.
Numerical equivalence with the historical feature cache or attribution of cross-cache differences to a single cause.
Tight predictive certificates: the mean CE upper bound of 9.60 is substantially above the observed changed CE of 0.459.
A new method, literature novelty, stronger L4 acceptance, or any same-core L5 contribution.
risks: Replacing a falsified collapse premise with a collapse-rescue architecture would lack evidential justification.
One cyclic reassignment jointly changes query-to-attention assignments; its effect does not isolate a unique mechanism or establish necessity.
Pairwise cohort means can conceal sentence-level collapse or heterogeneous effects.
The 234 certified decisions and 234 harmed predictions are distinct reported categories; equal counts do not imply identical membership.
Operational provenance and certificate compliance are accepted as supplied facts, not independently reverified here.
